# dsh-compat-optimize
中文说明

Fast path for **DSH plugin compatibility checks**: warm disk caches, one-shot compact reports,
and a
**zero-token offline CLI**.
A DSH plugin plus a standalone Node CLI. No build step, no runtime dependencies.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## 1. Why

`compat_check` (from `dsh-compat-check`) is an LLM tool: every call re-sends the tool schema,
a sing

le check usually takes 4–8 round trips at 40–100K input tokens each — while all the work
it does is
local. This plugin keeps the same verdicts and removes the round trips:
| Stage | Before | With this plugin |
| Tool schema | Re-sent with `tools[]` on every request (1,198 chars) | `compat_optimize` descriptio

n trimmed to 104 chars (tool definition ≈ 942 chars) |
| One check | 4–8 round trips | `action=run`

returns summary + report path + report body in one shot |
| Local compute | 283–552 ms, **69%** spen
t re-parsing the 4.76 MB `app.asar` header | Header parsed once, cached on disk and reused across pr

ocesses (183 ms cold → 85 ms warm) |
| Offline / CI | Only reachable through the model | `bin/compat
-check-cli.mjs` — 0 tokens, cron/CI friendly |

`deferLoading` does **not** save tokens: the host still projects the tool definition into every
requ
est. Shrinking the description is what saves them.

Drop the repository into your DSH plugins directory (default `<baseDir>/plugins`).
No build, no `npm

### Configuration

Defaults live in `cordis.patch.yml` and can be overridden per plugin id in your own profile
(**overr
ide replaces, it does not merge** — omit a field and it falls back to the schema default).
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `baseDir` | empty = `$DSH_COMPAT_BASE_DIR` / `$DSH_HOME` / home | Root for plugins, reports and ca

che |
| `pluginsDir` | empty = `baseDir/plugins` | Plugin directory to check |
| `installDir` | empt

y = auto-detect | DSH install dir (may point at `resources/app.asar`) |
| `outDir` | empty = `baseDi

r/out/compat` | Where reports are written |
| `cacheDir` | empty = `baseDir/.cache/compat-check` | C

ache directory (shared format with `dsh-compat-check`) |
| `iterations` | `5` | `bench` iterations |

| `warmOnStart` | `false` | Warm the cache when the plugin starts |
| `notesCacheTtlMs` | `21600000

` (6 h) | Upstream response cache TTL |
| `mainPluginDir` | empty = sibling `dsh-compat-check` | Whe

re to load the upstream check logic from |
| `deferLoading` | `true` | Defer tool visibility (does *
*not** save tokens) |
## 3. CLI (the zero-token deliverable)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Commands: `check` (default) · `status` · `warm` · `notes` · `bench`
| Option | Meaning |

| `--plugins-dir <dir>` | Plugin directory (default `<baseDir>/plugins`) |
| `--install-dir <dir>` |

DSH install dir (may point at `resources/app.asar`) |
| `--out-dir <dir>` | Report directory (defau

lt `<baseDir>/out/compat`) |
| `--cache-dir <dir>` | Cache directory (default `<baseDir>/.cache/comp

at-check`) |
| `--json` | Machine-readable output |
| `--warm` | Warm the cache before checking |
|

`--network` / `--offline` / `--refresh` | Network policy (off by default) |
| `--notes` | Compare ag

ainst upstream DSH releases |
| `--bench [N]` | Repeat N times and report timings |
| `--source <s>`
| `plugin` (default) · `optimized` · `fallback` |
**Exit codes:** `0` no broken plugins · `1` broken plugin found · `2` runtime error.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The CLI never touches the network unless `--notes`, `--refresh` or `--network` is given.
## 4. Tool actions
| `action` | What it does | Network |

| `status` | Cache state: header entries, freshness, last run summary | No |
| `warm` | Parse the `a

pp.asar` header and persist it | No (unless `withNetwork: true`) |
| `run` | Run a check, return com

pact summary + report path + report body | No |
| `bench` | Run N times, report median/min/max | No

|
| `notes` | Compare against upstream GitHub release + npm registry | On cache miss |

Parameters: `action` (required), `installDir`, `pluginsDir`, `outDir`, `cacheDir`, `iterations`,
`re
fresh`, `withNetwork`, `source`.
## 5. Cache layout
Default `<baseDir>/.cache/compat-check/`, byte-compatible with `dsh-compat-check`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Entries are validated by a **content fingerprint** (sha1 of the first 64 KB), not by `size` +
`mtime

Ms`: inside Electron, `fs.statSync('app.asar')` returns a synthetic stat (`size=0`,
`mtimeMs` = proc
ess start), which would invalidate the cache on every run.
## 6. Self-test
[代码示例省略，未执行]

~60 assertions covering cache hits/misses, TTL edges, all five actions, plugin registration and a
CL
I smoke test. Temporary artifacts go to the OS temp dir (`DSH_COMPAT_OPTIMIZE_TMPDIR` to override).

Everything runs without a DSH installation; the two assertions that import the DSH host packages
(`@
deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) are skipped when those packages are not resolvab
pseek-ai/schemastery`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) are skipped when those packages are not resolvable.
## 7. Benchmarks (Windows 11, Node 24)
Measured with `node bin/compat-check-cli.mjs check --json` (`elapsedMs`); the `checkPlugins` row is

the
median of 40 direct `checkPluginsFallback()` calls. Fixtures are synthetic plugin directories, e

ach with
`engines.dsh` plus three `@deepseek-ai/*` peer declarations — the shape of a real desktop i

h
`engines.dsh` plus three `@deepseek-ai/*` peer declarations — the shape of a real desktop install.
| Scenario | 20 plugins | 120 plugins |

| `checkPlugins` (scan only) | 4.8 ms | 26.6 ms |
[该节后续省略]
## 8. Requirements

- Node.js ≥ 20 (uses built-in `fetch`, `node:test`-free plain assertions)
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0

` when used as a plugin
- Optional: `dsh-compat-check` — without it the built-in fallback is used
